children: Spero Therapeutics established a new at-the-market equity program with Jefferies to sell up to $100 million of common stock under a pending Form S-3 shelf, and terminated its prior ATM agreement with Cantor effective August 28, 2026. Sales under the new program may begin once the registration statement is effective, with Jefferies earning up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. The shift is intended to maintain flexible access to capital while incurring no termination fees on the prior facility.
